camera_offset.scope: Optional original-count offsets for optical ratios, per channel, with saved versions and recording-level provenance.

cleanup.scope: Remove historical development records while preserving the release inventory, runtime definitions and regression checks.
cleanup.acceptance: The portable and desktop checks pass and the tagged release file list and hashes match.

open_decisions: Cutoff for linking candidate pockets between channels
Define the hypoxia-amyloid analysis as a separate task.
Decide whether to design a new vascular analysis feature.
Decide whether flagged sink references belong in between-channel comparisons.

pathway_cleanup.scope: Retire the original launcher, wrapper, curation app, iOS, vascular and legacy checking pathways so users start in the BOI Batch Editor.
pathway_cleanup.acceptance: Portable and desktop checks, repository inspection, release source validation and startup of both batch editors.

layout_cleanup.scope: Keep researcher entry points at the top level and group other files by purpose.
layout_cleanup.acceptance: Fresh-session startup, portable and desktop checks, repository inspection, the same release file count and a project-wide manifest from a synthetic run.

version_scheme.scope: Identify the code used for calculations and exports. The approved next release is 4.0.0, with a candidate first.
version_scheme.acceptance: Portable and desktop checks, source inventory and software identity from a synthetic recording.

release_automation.scope: Prepare a verified draft from a version tag and provide a development-branch package dry run.
release_automation.acceptance: Mac portable and desktop checks and a hosted dry run whose source ZIP and checksums match the validated inventory.
release_automation.stop: Pull request for researcher review. Publication is manual.
